name: Provenance® Woven Wood Shades
description: Provenance® Woven Wood Shades are hand-woven from natural materials like reeds, grasses, and woods, bringing organic texture and warmth to your home.

benefits.text:
Benefits
PowerView® Automation
The ultimate in home automation allowing you to control every shade with the touch of a button.
Independent Operable Liner
The freedom to turn the sheerest of any fabric into a room-darkening shade by combining the essence of natural 
woven shades with the energy efficiency of a honeycomb shade.
Fabric
Handcrafted from natural materials, from fine weaves to richly textured grass and wood, our fabrics are woven 
in innovative designs to create a versatile collection.
Four Product Styles
Roman, Recessed Roman, Waterfall Roman and Vertical Drapery styles provide both horizontal and vertical 
applications for every window and door in your home.

Nature’s Beauty Marks
Provenance® Woven Wood Shades are created from natural wood, reeds, bamboo and grasses. Variations in stain, pattern and knots are all unique 
characteristics that add to the natural beauty of the shade. The difference at Hunter Douglas is in the engineering and manufacturing. Our fabric 
construction and weaving techniques minimize bowing and twisting and enhance the durability. The attention to detail is worth taking another look 
at so you can SEE THE DIFFERENCE & UNDERSTAND THE BENEFITS.
What to Expect
Today’s fresh woven wood fabrics are created with lighter weight materials hand crafted to combine natural fibers into artful designs rich in texture 
and personality – letting the natural beauty of the materials show through. Our unique fabrics and patterns use a variety of natural materials harvested 
throughout the year and hand woven together. We carefully source our material to ensure consistency in appearance, yet each hand woven roll will 
have it’s own special characteristics. So what could be perceived as imperfections in the fabric are indeed part of the fabric’s natural and unique beauty.
Not All Woven Woods are Created Equal
